reasoning: The icon is a mobile OS status-bar indicator showing cellular signal bars as a right triangle with an exclamation mark for a network error or no reception. Outside a phone's status bar it looks like an abstract triangle or geometry symbol, and as a system status indicator it rarely represents a concrete to-do subject beyond niche mobile network troubleshooting.
